title: Too Early and Too Late
question: Why did the young girl miss the train?

meanings.usage: 指按时到达或完成某事的习惯
强调时间观念的重要性
形容社会或个人具有良好行为规范
指社会发展到较高阶段
指对不同意见或行为的宽恕态度
指对困难或不适的承受程度
形容复杂难理解的事物，常用于学术或科学问题
指对某人表示不满或指责
指责备的话语或状态
形容工作努力、认真的人
指造成麻烦或不便的人或事
法律用语中指侵害行为
指整体中的一小部分
数学术语
指旅行时携带的箱包等物品
指引人注意的戏剧性动作
指事物发展繁荣
形容非常小以至于难以察觉的事物
指旅行或运输的最终目的地
强调某事在某人心中的深刻印象
本意，指在表面上压出图案
指在车站、机场等帮人搬行李的人
形容态度坚决，不愿改变主意

phrases.usage: 使结束；得出结论，指完成某事或做出决定

examples.en: Only in this way can we bring the matter to a conclusion.
examples.zh: 只有这样我们才能结束这件事。

phrases.usage: 处于混乱状态，形容无秩序、混乱的局面

examples.en: Without rules, everything would be in a state of chaos.
examples.zh: 没有规则，一切都会陷入混乱。

phrases.usage: 把时间扣得很紧，指在最后时刻才完成任务或到达

examples.en: He always cuts things fine when catching trains.
examples.zh: 他赶火车时总是把时间扣得很紧。

phrases.usage: 出发；动身，指开始旅程或着手做某事

examples.en: They set out for the station early in the morning.
examples.zh: 他们一大早就出发去车站了。

phrases.usage: 使深刻印象；叮嘱，强调某事的重要性让某人记住

examples.en: Her parents impressed upon her that punctuality was important.
examples.zh: 她的父母让她深刻记住准时的重要性。

phrases.usage: 指出；指明，用于提示或解释某事

examples.en: The station master pointed out the mistake on the timetable.
examples.zh: 站长指出时刻表上的错误。

phrases.usage: 溜进；悄悄进入，指不引人注意地进入某处

examples.en: She tried to slip into the train before it left.
examples.zh: 她试图在火车开走前溜进去。

phrases.usage: 使她恐惧的是，用于引出令人害怕或震惊的情况

examples.en: To her horror, the train had already left.
examples.zh: 使她恐惧的是，火车已经开走了。

phrases.usage: 和...一样（用于比较），强调两者在某方面程度相同

examples.en: The over-punctual can be as much a trial as the unpunctual.
examples.zh: 过于准时的人和不准时的人一样让人头疼。

phrases.usage: 不可原谅的，指错误严重到无法被原谅

examples.en: It would be unforgivable to miss the train.
examples.zh: 错过这班火车将是不可原谅的。

sentences.en: Punctuality is a necessary habit in all public affairs in civilized society.
sentences.zh: 在文明社会中，准时是处理一切公共事务的必要习惯。

sentences.en: Without it, nothing could ever be brought to a conclusion; everything would be in a state of chaos.
sentences.zh: 没有它，任何事情都无法成功；一切都将处于混乱之中。

sentences.en: Only in a sparsely-populated rural community is it possible to disregard it.
sentences.zh: 只有在人口稀少的乡村社区，才有可能忽视它。

sentences.en: In ordinary living, there can be some tolerance of unpunctuality.
sentences.zh: 在日常生活中，对不准时可以有一些宽容。

sentences.en: The intellectual, who is working on some abstruse problem, has everything coordinated and organized for the matter in hand.
sentences.zh: 正在研究某个深奥问题的知识分子，会把手头的一切事物都协调组织好。

sentences.en: He is therefore forgiven if late for a dinner party.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果他赴晚宴迟到了，是可以被原谅的。

sentences.en: But people are often reproached for unpunctuality when their only fault is cutting things fine.
sentences.zh: 但人们常常因为不准时而受到指责，尽管他们唯一的过错只是把时间安排得太紧凑。

sentences.en: It is hard for energetic, quick-minded people to waste time,
sentences.zh: 对于精力充沛、头脑敏捷的人来说，浪费时间是很难的，

sentences.en: so they are often tempted to finish a job before setting out to keep an appointment.
sentences.zh: 所以他们常常想在赴约之前完成一项工作。

sentences.en: If no accidents occur on the way, like punctured tyres, diversions of traffic, sudden descent of fog, they will be on time.
sentences.zh: 如果路上没有发生意外，比如爆胎、交通改道、突如其来的大雾，他们就会准时到达。

sentences.en: They are often more industrious, useful citizens than those who are never late.
sentences.zh: 他们往往比那些从不迟到的人更勤劳、更有用。

sentences.en: The over-punctual can be as much a trial to others as the unpunctual.
sentences.zh: 过分准时的人和不准时的人一样，都会给别人带来麻烦。

sentences.en: The guest who arrives half an hour too soon is the greatest nuisance.
sentences.zh: 提前半小时到达的客人是最让人讨厌的。

sentences.en: Some friends of my family had this irritating habit.
sentences.zh: 我家里有些朋友就有这种令人恼火的习惯。

sentences.en: The only thing to do was ask them to come half an hour later than the other guests.
sentences.zh: 唯一的办法就是请他们比其他客人晚半小时来。

sentences.en: Then they arrived just when we wanted them.
sentences.zh: 这样他们就能在我们想要的时候到达。

sentences.en: If you are catching a train, it is always better to be comfortably early than even a fraction of a minute too late.
sentences.zh: 如果你要赶火车，最好是提前充足时间，而不是哪怕晚一分钟。

sentences.en: Although being early may mean wasting a little time,
sentences.zh: 尽管提前到达可能会浪费一点时间，

sentences.en: this will be less than if you miss the train and have to wait an hour or more for the next one;
sentences.zh: 但这比你错过火车，不得不等一个多小时才能搭乘下一班车要好；

sentences.en: and you avoid the frustration of arriving at the very moment when the train is drawing out of the station and being unable to get on it.
sentences.zh: 而且你还能避免那种火车正驶出车站而你却无法上车的沮丧。

sentences.en: An even harder situation is to be on the platform in good time for a train and still to see it go off without you.
sentences.zh: 更令人恼火的情况是，你准时到了站台，却眼睁睁看着火车没有你开走。

sentences.en: Such an experience befell a certain young girl the first time she was travelling alone.
sentences.zh: 这样的经历就发生在一个年轻女孩身上，那是她第一次独自旅行。

sentences.en: She entered the station twenty minutes before the train was due,
sentences.zh: 她在火车到站前20分钟就进了车站，

sentences.en: since her parents had impressed upon her
sentences.zh: 因为她的父母曾告诫她

sentences.en: that it would be unforgivable to miss it and cause the friends with whom she was going to stay to make two journeys to meet her.
sentences.zh: 错过火车是不可原谅的，那会让她要去拜访的朋友来接她两次。

sentences.en: She gave her luggage to a porter and showed him her ticket.
sentences.zh: 她把行李交给一个搬运工，并给他看了她的车票。

sentences.en: To her horror he said that she was two hours too soon.
sentences.zh: 让她吃惊的是，他说她早来了两个小时。

sentences.en: She felt in her handbag for the piece of paper on which her father had written down all the details of the journey and gave it to the porter.
sentences.zh: 她从手提包里摸索出父亲写下所有旅行细节的纸条，交给了搬运工。

sentences.en: He agreed that a train did come into the station at the time on the paper and that it did stop, but only to take on mail, not passengers.
sentences.zh: 他承认火车确实在纸上写的时间到达车站，也确实停靠了，但那只是为了装载邮件，而不是载客。

sentences.en: The girl asked to see a timetable, feeling sure that her father could not have made such a mistake.
sentences.zh: 女孩要求看时刻表，她确信她父亲不可能犯这样的错误。

sentences.en: The porter went to fetch one and arrived back with the station master,
sentences.zh: 搬运工去拿时刻表，回来时带着站长，

sentences.en: who produced it with a flourish and pointed out a microscopic 'o' beside the time of the arrival of the train at his station;
sentences.zh: 站长得意地拿出时刻表，指出了他们车站火车到站时间旁边的一个微小的“o”；

sentences.en: this little 'o' indicated that the train only stopped for mail.
sentences.zh: 这个小小的“o”表示火车只停靠装载邮件。

sentences.en: Just as that moment the train came into the station.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，火车进站了。

sentences.en: The girl, tears streaming down her face, begged to be allowed to slip into the guard's van.
sentences.zh: 女孩泪流满面，乞求允许她溜进守车。

sentences.en: But the station master was adamant: rules could not be broken.
sentences.zh: 但站长态度坚决：规则不能打破。

sentences.en: And she had to watch that train disappear towards her destination while she was left behind.
sentences.zh: 她不得不眼睁睁看着那列火车开往目的地，而她却被留在了原地。

exercises.explain: flourish · /ˈflʌrɪʃ/ · noun · 夸张的动作；挥舞。指引人注意的戏剧性动作

exercises.hint: 错过这班火车将是不可原谅的。

exercises.hint: 如果路上没有发生意外，比如爆胎、交通改道、突如其来的大雾，他们就会准时到达。
exercises.explain: If no accidents occur on the way, like punctured tyres, diversions of traffic, sudden descent of fog, they will be on time. — 如果路上没有发生意外，比如爆胎、交通改道、突如其来的大雾，他们就会准时到达。

source.en: If no accidents occur on the way, like punctured tyres, diversions of traffic, sudden descent of fog, they will be on time.

exercises.prompt: “表示太...以至于不能...，too后接形容词，to后接动词原形” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: too + 形容词/副词 + (for sb.) + to do sth.
options: 否定副词置于句首的倒装句
exercises.explain: too...to... 结构：too + 形容词/副词 + (for sb.) + to do sth.：表达程度过高导致不可能实现的情况

exercises.prompt:
选出下面句子的正确中文意思：

约翰那天生意很好，就把装有3000英镑的钱包放进了微波炉里，以求安全。

exercises.explain: The guest who arrives half an hour too soon is the greatest nuisance. — 提前半小时到达的客人是最让人讨厌的。

source.en: The guest who arrives half an hour too soon is the greatest nuisance.

grammar.title: 条件句 (If引导的真实条件句)
grammar.definition: 表示真实可能发生的情况，使用if引导的条件状语从句
grammar.structure: If + 一般现在时, 主语 + will/won't + 动词原形
grammar.usage: 用于讨论可能发生的真实情况，提出假设或条件

examples.en: If no accidents occur on the way, they will be on time.
examples.zh: 如果路上没有事故，他们会准时到达。

examples.en: If you are catching a train, it is better to be early.
examples.zh: 如果你要赶火车，最好早一点。

grammar.title: Only + 状语 置于句首的倒装
grammar.definition: 当only置于句首修饰状语时，句子需要部分倒装
grammar.structure: Only + 状语 + be/助动词/情态动词 + 主语 + 其他
grammar.usage: 强调条件或方式，突出唯一性

examples.en: Only in a sparsely-populated rural community is it possible to disregard punctuality.
examples.zh: 只有在人口稀少的农村社区才可能忽视守时。

examples.en: Only then did she realize her mistake.
examples.zh: 直到那时她才意识到自己的错误。

grammar.title: too...to... 结构
grammar.definition: 表示太...以至于不能...，too后接形容词，to后接动词原形
grammar.structure: too + 形容词/副词 + (for sb.) + to do sth.
grammar.usage: 表达程度过高导致不可能实现的情况

examples.en: She was two hours too early.
examples.zh: 她早了两个小时。

examples.en: It is too difficult for a child to understand.
examples.zh: 这对一个孩子来说太难理解了。

patterns.pattern: It is + adj. + for sb. + to do sth.

original.en: It is hard for energetic, quick-minded people to waste time.
original.zh: 对于精力充沛、思维敏捷的人来说，浪费时间是很困难的。

examples.en: It is necessary for us to be punctual.
examples.zh: 对我们来说守时是必要的。

examples.en: It is important for students to practice English every day.
examples.zh: 对学生来说每天练习英语是重要的。

patterns.pattern: Only in + 地点/时间 + is it possible to...

original.en: Only in a sparsely-populated rural community is it possible to disregard it.
original.zh: 只有在人口稀少的农村社区才可能忽视它。

examples.en: Only in this way can we solve the problem.
examples.zh: 只有用这种方法我们才能解决问题。

examples.en: Only in Beijing can you see such historical sites.
examples.zh: 只有在北京你才能看到这样的历史遗迹。

patterns.pattern: The + adj. + can be as much...as...

original.en: The over-punctual can be as much a trial to others as the unpunctual.
original.zh: 过于准时的人和不准时的人一样让人头疼。

examples.en: The rich can be as unhappy as the poor.
examples.zh: 富人和穷人一样可能不快乐。

examples.en: Being early can be as bad as being late.
examples.zh: 来得太早和迟到一样糟糕。

patterns.pattern: It would be + 形容词 + to do sth.

original.en: It would be unforgivable to miss it.
original.zh: 错过它将是不可原谅的。

examples.en: It would be foolish to give up now.
examples.zh: 现在放弃是愚蠢的。

examples.en: It would be wise to arrive early.
examples.zh: 早点到是明智的。
